component.name: Strata
component.summary: Native GPU-accelerated local database client and schema diffing utility

description.p: Strata is a native, GPU-accelerated desktop database client and declarative schema diffing utility built in pure Rust with Zed's GPUI framework.

Designed for embedded and analytical data files including SQLite, DuckDB, libSQL, and Apache Parquet, Strata renders query results directly from Apache Arrow RecordBatches and generates SQLite and DuckDB schema migrations.
Material Design 3 UI redesign, custom theme studio with Hazy Aerostat Blue-Gray / Steel Indigo / Soft Dried Apricot / Faded Ice Cyan default palette, and Windows window modifier fixes.
CI pipeline optimization with runner cache pruning and build maintenance.
Complete UI redesign with integrated custom titlebar window controls, static MinGW runtime bundling on Windows, Linux Flatpak distribution, and automatic release update checking.
Windows MSI installer and Common Controls v6 manifest hotfix.
